status: all seasons seen-data; source-quality repair and diagnostic only; no simulation, engine/card changes or accuracy promotion

definitions.sample: exact same anchors/possession boundaries/special-FT exclusions as step4-rebounds-paths; retain count and all unzoned fields
definitions.three: actionType 3pt always long; do not infer from success
definitions.short: recognized Restricted Area or In The Paint unchanged; for nominal Mid-Range conflicting with near-basket evidence apply rule below
definitions.repair: only 2pt, original area Mid-Range, layup/dunk/tip/putback action text, numeric shotDistance in [0,4] feet, finite normalized x,y in [0,100], nearest-hoop geometric distance <=4 feet => short
definitions.geometry: hoop normalized x=5.59 or94.41,y=50; x distance *0.94 ft, y distance *0.50 ft; use nearest hoop; tolerance limit exactly4ft
definitions.uncertain: nominal Mid-Range plus any near-basket text, distance<=4 or valid geometry<=4, but repair conditions not all met => unknown; never default unknown areas to mid
definitions.mid: recognized Mid-Range without near-basket conflict stays mid
definitions.unknown: unrecognized/missing 2pt area or unresolved contradictory evidence; keep separate FG bin, retain points/FGA
definitions.invariants: same player/game anchors, 2/3-point score, FGM/FGA, FG reached, loss-before-attempt, FT, repeat rebounds and full possession points; compare row projection exactly
definitions.simulation: reuse existing same-seed frozen step4-rebounds-paths outputs; no RNG or rerun
definitions.comparison: recompute real zone/quick same-shooter short <=3sec proxy; keep frozen simulation predictions; 20000 franchise+seed paired bootstrap, equal season; no adoption claims
definitions.putbackProxy: first FG following eligible player FG OREB; same shooter short zone and clock difference<=3 seconds; do not call official putbacks or landing coordinates
definitions.scope: do not alter raw PBP, card construction, older reports or constants; unresolved labels reported
